sources.locator: Resolution 59-2025 page 1: original 88-2023 recital, last seven-month estimate, paragraphs 1–2 scope and June 30, 2026 scheduled end; page 2: signed November 25, 2025 adoption.
Resolution 16-2026 page 1 section 3 expressly ends 59-2025 upon passage/approval; page 2 signed approval April 14, 2026.
sources.reuse: Retained November5 source reused without refetch; body/text hashes and both signed/operative pages checked.

findings: Signed Resolution 59-2025 recites that original 88-2023 imposed the BESS moratorium December 27, 2023. This is primary county retrospective evidence, not direct inspection of 88-2023.

Resolution 59-2025 is signed November 25, 2025 and estimates seven additional months; operative paragraph 2 sets June 30, 2026 unless terminated or extended. It acknowledges several prior extensions but does not establish all were seven months.
Paragraph 1 bars accepting, processing or approving applications, including special-use and right-of-way permits, for BESS land development in unincorporated Washington County.

Signed Resolution 16-2026 section 3 expressly ends 59-2025 upon passage and approval; signed approval is April 14, 2026. This is direct termination evidence, not inference from later web-listing absence.
resolution: Correct the original-date attribution and unsupported repeated-seven-month claim. The bounded historical identity, last-extension and express termination account is now source-supported. Do not assert all earlier extension dates/terms or current force of replacement zoning.
scope: One exact-byte original recovery; one reused signed termination source; four pages visually reviewed.
